piiFields.description: piiFields are suppressed from the dataset by generating fake data in their place

quasiIds.description: quasiIds are used by data anonymization algorithm to generalize specific fields from the dataset.

include.description:
Include spec indicating how far to traverse references for anonymization.  If not specify, only fields directly
owned by the type being anonymized will be included.  If specified only fields indicated by the include will be
included though they may be references to entity type fields outside of the type being anonymized.

kAnonymityFactor.description:
Specify the least number of data points which should be same across all the QuasifierIdentifiers (QuasiIds )
fields for each record in the dataset. In other word, to specify the k in K-anonymity property in the dataset

K-anonymity property: a dataset is K-anonymous, when each row has quasi-identifiers attributes that
are suppressed or generalized until each row is identical with at least k-1 other rows. At this point
the data is said to be confidential or K-anonymous.

Higher value of k means higher confidentiality but also more information loss due to anonymization.
Lower value of k means lower confidentiality but also less information loss due to anonymization.

Choose value according to the use case but if unspecified, then a default value of `5` is used.
